description: This file contains Go source code defining data structures and functions for managing EndpointSlices in Kubernetes, including actions like create, update, delete, and recycling slices, as well as calculating desired endpoints and ports.

classes.name: slicesByAction
classes.description: Includes lists of EndpointSlices to create, update, or delete.

classes.name: totalsByAction
classes.description: Tracks total numbers of added, updated, and removed EndpointSlices.

classes.name: desiredCalc
classes.description: Helps calculate desired endpoints and ports based on current state.

classes.name: multiAddrTypePortMapKey
classes.description: Stores address type specific keys for ports and endpoints.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends slices from another slicesByAction struct.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds totals from another totalsByAction struct.

methods.name: newDesiredCalc
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new desiredCalc instance.

methods.name: initPorts
methods.description: Initializes ports for a subset and address type, returning the corresponding key.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds an EndpointAddress to the desired state if valid.

methods.name: recycleSlices
methods.description: Recycles slices marked for deletion by replacing creates with updates.

methods.name: removeSlice
methods.description: Removes an EndpointSlice from a list.
